question: Approve the ideation design of comment-check-reaches-delivery-gate to enter implementation, with decisions D1-D3 as the Captain rules each one in the batch-4 sitting (listed first, asked one at a time)? An approval accepts a decision's recommendation only where his ruling says so; a decision he changes is recorded in the reason, and a scope change goes in as an amendment.
